This is what doesn't make Strapi qualified to be in the run for a solid and flexible CMS in projects at work. Not trying to trash the team or anybody using it ❤️, but just as Njoodd expressing the lack of it. It's just a shame because this issue has been brought up numerous times and been shot down. I decided just last week to use Strapi for my upcoming project but already changed my mind because I'm having issues to visualise how to build a non flexible solution with very little if any reusability with the components. Not to mention that the industry has been on the component train for a long time now for this to be a minor thing. Not having more levels of nesting makes developers finding "hacks" when modelling and making the solution more specific then generic, at the same time adding complexity to the frontend.

As I said not trying to bring anybody down. I love a lot about Strapi but this is the last obstacle for me.
